note: What each toilet block on the map holds, read off the door signs in the school's virtual tour (tools/tourkit; read 31 October 2026). The signs: girls' and boys' toilets say 'Students only'; men's, women's and all-gender ('adults') toilets 'Adults only'; neither may use the other's. Older plates show only a woman or a man ('female', 'male'). 'accessible' is a wheelchair toilet (in Toh Tuck signed 'Adults only'). Keys are the app's place keys. confidence: 'read' = the words or plates were read; 'likely' = the pictograms and colours were seen, the words too far to read; 'signs' = not seen, from the direction signs; 'map' = the map's own name; 'cad' = the architect's CAD: its fixtures (urinals, cubicles, a turning circle) and its room words -- male or female, students or adults only where it says STAFF (3 Nov 2026). Read by app/search.js (names, the Toilets choices) and drawn on the map.
